name: PAT_SVC_PROV_LIST_RECPNT
description: This table stores information of service provider list recipients that received the list through a guest link.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number for this contact. This number is unique across all patient encounters in your system. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Unique Contact Identifier (UCI).

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: CM_CT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this contact. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: LIST_IDENT
columns.description: The unique ID in I EPT 97216 for the list that the recipient information is for.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider list recipient.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_CONTACT_METHOD_C_NAME
columns.description: The contact method used to send the service provider list to the recipient.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_PHONE
columns.description: The phone number that was used to send the service provider list to the recipient.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_EMAIL
columns.description: The email that was used to send the service provider list to the recipient.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_IS_NEW_CONTACT_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether the recipient of a Patient Choice list is a new visit contact created when sharing the list.
